excluded_reference_values.0: Zero does not identify a transmitting radio and must not count as an AFPD match.
excluded_reference_values.-1: Negative one does not identify a transmitting radio and must not count as an AFPD match.

_metadata.reference_scope: IDs observed in archived TG6001 calls and retained TG6036 inventory; matches do not establish officer identity.
_metadata.days_value_definition: Unique source radio IDs matching the reference list, observed in this talkgroup on this Mountain Time date.
_metadata.empty_list_definition: No matching IDs observed; daily_counts distinguishes no calls from calls without matches.
_metadata.matching_calls_definition: Recording IDs, timestamps, media URLs, and matching source radio IDs for future selective archiving.
